# SOP-P2-L2-03 First-article inspection - Ring Rolling line
Revision: Rev B
Plant: P2, line P2-L2
Equipment: EQ-P2-L2-IH01, EQ-P2-L2-HT02, EQ-P2-L2-RR03
Related documents: ECN-2026-012, ECN-2026-028, SB-1017

Purpose
1. Define the standard operating procedure for first-article inspection (FAI) of ring products produced on the Ring Rolling line (P2-L2) using induction heater EQ-P2-L2-IH01, heat treat furnace EQ-P2-L2-HT02, and radial ring rolling mill EQ-P2-L2-RR03. This procedure ensures the first part of a new production run meets dimensional, metallurgical and process conformance criteria prior to full production.

Scope and background
2. This SOP applies to all first-article rings produced following any ECN or tooling change that affects forming, heat treat, or rolling set-up on P2-L2. Use ECN-2026-012 and ECN-2026-028 for engineering change details and SB-1017 for inspection form templates and record retention. First-article inspection includes visual, dimensional, hardness, microstructure, and procedural confirmation steps that verify transferred settings and fixtures on the line.

Preconditions (to verify before starting FAI)
3. Confirm release from Engineering: ECN-2026-012 or ECN-2026-028 as applicable.
4. Verify fixtures, tooling and machine guards are installed per the job traveler and SB-1017.
5. Confirm FAI sample material matches purchase order and material certification is present.
6. Confirm calibration stickers on all inspection gauges and on EQ-P2-L2-RR03 spindle indicator are valid per SB-1017.
7. Confirm safety system and interlocks on EQ-P2-L2-IH01, EQ-P2-L2-HT02, and EQ-P2-L2-RR03 are functional.

PPE
8. Required PPE for personnel performing FAI:
   - Safety glasses with side shields
   - Cut-resistant gloves for handling rings
   - Hearing protection when in proximity to EQ-P2-L2-RR03 during rolling
   - Heat-resistant gloves and face shield when removing parts from EQ-P2-L2-IH01 or EQ-P2-L2-HT02
   - Steel-toed footwear
   - Long sleeve protection for hot material handling

Rationale and critical check-points
9. First-article inspection validates both equipment set-up and procedural adherence. Sample checks during FAI protect against scrap generation and detect deviations due to tooling mismatch, set-up error, or process drift. Examples:
   - Dimensional verification at the ring OD and radial section confirms RR03 roll position and feed.
   - Metallurgical checks after EQ-P2-L2-HT02 confirm the established heat cycle and cooling are producing the required microstructure.
   - Visual and hardness checks confirm there are no surface decarburization or quench anomalies.

Mandatory values
10. The quench delay maximum for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P2-L2-HT02) is 16 seconds.
11. The maximum ring outer diameter for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #3 (EQ-P2-L2-RR03) is 1525 mm.

Inspection steps (numbered sequence)
12. Step 1 — Job setup verification
    - Review the job traveler and ECN documents for the part number and configuration. Confirm tooling identifiers on machines match the job traveler.
    - Confirm material certification and heat number are available.

13. Step 2 — Machine warm-up and baseline check
    - Place machines in FAI mode per machine HMI. Verify interlocks and E-stops are functional. Record any alarms.

14. Step 3 — Induction heat and preform check (EQ-P2-L2-IH01)
    - Load first-piece preform. Confirm induction coil alignment and clamp engagement per the job traveler.
    - Perform a visual check for centering and clamp marks after induction heat.

15. Step 4 — Rolling set verification (EQ-P2-L2-RR03)
    - Mount the induction-hot preform on RR03 per fixture drawing. Confirm roll positions and backup roll engagement.
    - Perform an initial roll pass and measure ring runout and radial section at specified inspection points on the FAI form (SB-1017). If runout exceeds acceptance criteria, stop and notify Engineering.

16. Step 5 — Dimensional verification
    - Measure outer diameter and key features per drawing. Record measurements on the FAI inspection sheet. The maximum ring outer diameter for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #3 (EQ-P2-L2-RR03) is 1525 mm; verify recorded values do not exceed this limit.
    - If any dimension is out of tolerance, tag the part and halt production until disposition is made.

17. Step 6 — Heat treat confirmation (EQ-P2-L2-HT02)
    - Transfer the ring to EQ-P2-L2-HT02 using approved handling methods. Confirm chain-of-custody on the FAI log.
    - Record furnace start/stop cycle identifiers and the observed quench delay. The quench delay maximum for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P2-L2-HT02) is 16 seconds; log actual delay and include operator initials.

18. Step 7 — Hardness and microstructure
    - After heat treat, perform hardness readings per SB-1017 sampling locations. Prepare metallographic samples as required and forward to lab with the FAI documentation.
    - Record microstructure results and identify any nonconforming features (e.g., incomplete transformation, grain boundary issues).

19. Step 8 — Final visual inspection and surface quality
    - Inspect for surface defects, scale, or decarb. Document findings and include photographs when anomalies exist.

20. Step 9 — Nonconformance handling
    - If any inspection step fails, complete a nonconformance report and reference ECN-2026-012 or ECN-2026-028 as the authorization for any hold or rework. Notify Quality and Engineering immediately.

Records to keep
21. Maintain the following records in the document control system and attach to the part lot:
    - Completed FAI inspection sheet (use SB-1017 template)
    - Material certificate and heat number traceability
    - Dimensional measurement records and photos
    - Hardness and metallographic lab reports
    - Machine event logs for EQ-P2-L2-IH01, EQ-P2-L2-HT02 and EQ-P2-L2-RR03
    - Any nonconformance reports and dispositions
    - Quench delay log entry for EQ-P2-L2-HT02 with operator initials

Examples and rationale
22. Example: If the recorded ring outer diameter approaches the maximum ring outer diameter for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #3 (EQ-P2-L2-RR03) is 1525 mm, adjust roll pass schedule or consult Engineering before proceeding. Document the decision and reference ECN-2026-028 when the adjustment is due to an engineering change.
23. Example: If quench delay is logged beyond the quench delay maximum for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P2-L2-HT02) is 16 seconds, stop production and inspect furnace controls and load handling. Record the event and notify Quality for disposition per ECN-2026-012.

Sign-off (who must complete)
24. Operator: print name, signature, date, time, equipment IDs used (EQ-P2-L2-IH01, EQ-P2-L2-HT02, EQ-P2-L2-RR03).
25. Process Engineer: print name, signature, date — confirms set-up and provides disposition for go/no-go.
26. Quality Inspector: print name, signature, date — confirms dimensional and metallurgical acceptance per SB-1017.

Revision control
27. This SOP references ECN-2026-012, ECN-2026-028, and SB-1017 for change history, tooling specifications, and inspection templates. Any deviation from this SOP requires ECN approval and an updated revision entry.
